logic_node.action: Titrate GDMT to target doses from RCTs
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, titration of guideline-directed medication dosing to achieve target doses shown to be efficacious in RCTs is recommended to reduce cardiovascular mortality and HF hospitalizations, unless not well tolerated.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, titration of guideline-directed medication dosing to achieve target doses showed to be efficacious in RCTs is recommended, to reduce cardiovascular mortality and HF hospitalizations, unless not well tolerated.

logic_node.action: Uptitrate GDMT every 1-2 weeks
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, titration and optimization of guideline-directed medications as frequently as every 1 to 2 weeks depending on the patient's symptoms, vital signs, and laboratory findings can be useful to optimize management.

source_text: In patients with HFrEF, titration and optimization of guideline-directed medications as frequently as every 1 to 2 weeks depending on the patient's symptoms, vital signs, and laboratory findings can be useful to optimize management.

logic_node.action: Monitor heart rate, BP, electrolytes, renal function during uptitration
logic_node.action_detail: Patients should be monitored for changes in heart rate, blood pressure, electrolytes, renal function, and symptoms during the GDMT uptitration period. Planned uptitration of a HF medication should be delayed until any adverse effects observed with lower doses have resolved.

source_text: Patients should be monitored for changes in heart rate, blood pressure, electrolytes, renal function, and symptoms during this uptitration period. Planned uptitration should be delayed until any adverse effects observed with lower doses have resolved.

logic_node.action: Individualize GDMT sequencing based on patient factors
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with HFrEF, simultaneous initiation or sequencing and order of guideline-directed medications are usually individualized according to patient's symptoms, vital signs, functional status, tolerance, renal function, electrolytes, comorbidities, specific cause of HF, and ability of follow-up, and does not necessarily need to be done according to the sequence of trial publications.

source_text: Simultaneous initiation or sequencing, and order of guideline-directed medications are usually individualized according to patient's symptoms, vital signs, functional status, tolerance, renal function, electrolytes, comorbidities.

logic_node.action: Captopril dosing: start 6.25 mg TID, target 50 mg TID
logic_node.action_detail: Captopril for HFrEF: initial dose 6.25 mg 3 times daily, target dose 50 mg 3 times daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 122.7 mg total daily.

source_text: Captopril: 6.25 mg 3 times daily initial, 50 mg 3 times daily target, 122.7 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Enalapril dosing: start 2.5 mg BID, target 10-20 mg BID
logic_node.action_detail: Enalapril for HFrEF: initial dose 2.5 mg twice daily, target dose 10-20 mg twice daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 16.6 mg total daily.

source_text: Enalapril: 2.5 mg twice daily initial, 10-20 mg twice daily target, 16.6 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Lisinopril dosing: start 2.5-5 mg daily, target 20-40 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Lisinopril for HFrEF: initial dose 2.5-5 mg once daily, target dose 20-40 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 32.5-35.0 mg total daily.

source_text: Lisinopril: 2.5-5 mg once daily initial, 20-40 mg once daily target, 32.5-35.0 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Ramipril dosing: start 1.25-2.5 mg daily, target 10 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Ramipril for HFrEF: initial dose 1.25-2.5 mg once daily, target dose 10 mg once daily.

source_text: Ramipril: 1.25-2.5 mg once daily initial, 10 mg once daily target.

logic_node.action: Candesartan dosing: start 4-8 mg daily, target 32 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Candesartan for HFrEF: initial dose 4-8 mg once daily, target dose 32 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 24 mg total daily.

source_text: Candesartan: 4-8 mg once daily initial, 32 mg once daily target, 24 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Losartan dosing: start 25-50 mg daily, target 50-150 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Losartan for HFrEF: initial dose 25-50 mg once daily, target dose 50-150 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 129 mg total daily.

source_text: Losartan: 25-50 mg once daily initial, 50-150 mg once daily target, 129 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Valsartan dosing: start 20-40 mg daily, target 160 mg BID
logic_node.action_detail: Valsartan for HFrEF: initial dose 20-40 mg once daily, target dose 160 mg twice daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 254 mg total daily.

source_text: Valsartan: 20-40 mg once daily initial, 160 mg twice daily target, 254 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Sacubitril/valsartan dosing: start 49/51 mg BID, target 97/103 mg BID
logic_node.action_detail: Sacubitril/valsartan for HFrEF: initial dose 49 mg sacubitril/51 mg valsartan twice daily (may initiate at 24/26 mg BID), target dose 97 mg sacubitril/103 mg valsartan twice daily. Mean dose in trials: 182/193 mg total daily.

source_text: Sacubitril-valsartan: 49/51 mg twice daily initial (may initiate at 24/26 mg BID), 97/103 mg twice daily target, 182/193 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Bisoprolol dosing: start 1.25 mg daily, target 10 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Bisoprolol for HFrEF: initial dose 1.25 mg once daily, target dose 10 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 8.6 mg total daily.

source_text: Bisoprolol: 1.25 mg once daily initial, 10 mg once daily target, 8.6 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Carvedilol dosing: start 3.125 mg BID, target 25-50 mg BID
logic_node.action_detail: Carvedilol for HFrEF: initial dose 3.125 mg twice daily, target dose 25-50 mg twice daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 37 mg total daily. Carvedilol CR: initial 10 mg daily, target 80 mg daily.

source_text: Carvedilol: 3.125 mg twice daily initial, 25-50 mg twice daily target, 37 mg total daily mean. Carvedilol CR: 10 mg daily initial, 80 mg daily target.

logic_node.action: Metoprolol succinate dosing: start 12.5-25 mg daily, target 200 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Metoprolol succinate extended release (CR/XL) for HFrEF: initial dose 12.5-25 mg once daily, target dose 200 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 159 mg total daily.

source_text: Metoprolol succinate extended release: 12.5-25 mg once daily initial, 200 mg once daily target, 159 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Spironolactone dosing: start 12.5-25 mg daily, target 25-50 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Spironolactone for HFrEF: initial dose 12.5-25 mg once daily, target dose 25-50 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 26 mg total daily.

source_text: Spironolactone: 12.5-25 mg once daily initial, 25-50 mg once daily target, 26 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Eplerenone dosing: start 25 mg daily, target 50 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Eplerenone for HFrEF: initial dose 25 mg once daily, target dose 50 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 42.6 mg total daily.

source_text: Eplerenone: 25 mg once daily initial, 50 mg once daily target, 42.6 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Dapagliflozin dosing: 10 mg daily (no titration needed)
logic_node.action_detail: Dapagliflozin for HFrEF: initial and target dose 10 mg once daily (no titration required). Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 9.8 mg total daily.

source_text: Dapagliflozin: 10 mg once daily initial, 10 mg once daily target, 9.8 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Empagliflozin dosing: 10 mg daily (no titration needed)
logic_node.action_detail: Empagliflozin for HFrEF: initial and target dose 10 mg once daily (no titration required).

source_text: Empagliflozin: 10 mg once daily initial, 10 mg once daily target.

logic_node.action: Hydralazine/ISDN fixed-dose: start 20/37.5 mg TID, target 40/75 mg TID
logic_node.action_detail: Fixed-dose combination isosorbide dinitrate/hydralazine for HFrEF: initial dose 20 mg ISDN/37.5 mg hydralazine 3 times daily, target 40 mg ISDN/75 mg hydralazine 3 times daily. Mean dose in trials: 90 mg ISDN/~175 mg hydralazine total daily.

source_text: Fixed dose combination: 20 mg isosorbide dinitrate and 37.5 mg hydralazine 3 times daily initial, 40 mg ISDN and 75 mg hydralazine 3 times daily target.

logic_node.action: Consider ivabradine to reduce HF hospitalization and CV death
logic_node.action_detail: For patients with symptomatic (NYHA class II-III) stable chronic HFrEF (LVEF <=35%) receiving GDMT including a beta blocker at maximum tolerated dose, in sinus rhythm with heart rate >=70 bpm at rest, ivabradine can be beneficial to reduce HF hospitalizations and cardiovascular death.

source_text: For patients with symptomatic (NYHA class II to III) stable chronic HFrEF (LVEF <= 35%) who are receiving GDMT, including a beta blocker at maximum tolerated dose, and who are in sinus rhythm with a heart rate of >= 70 bpm at rest, ivabradine can be beneficial.

logic_node.action: Ivabradine dosing: start 5 mg BID, target 7.5 mg BID
logic_node.action_detail: Ivabradine for HFrEF: initial dose 5 mg twice daily, target dose 7.5 mg twice daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 12.8 mg total daily. Beta blocker should be initiated and uptitrated to target doses before assessing resting heart rate for ivabradine initiation.

source_text: Ivabradine: 5 mg twice daily initial, 7.5 mg twice daily target, 12.8 total daily mean in trials. Beta blockers should be uptitrated to target doses before assessing resting heart rate for ivabradine.

logic_node.action: Maximize beta blocker before starting ivabradine
logic_node.action_detail: Given the well-proven mortality benefits of beta-blocker therapy, beta blockers should be initiated and uptitrated to target doses, as tolerated, before assessing the resting heart rate for consideration of ivabradine initiation. Only 25% of patients in SHIFT were on optimal doses of beta-blocker therapy.

source_text: Given the well-proven mortality benefits of beta-blocker therapy, these agents should be initiated and uptitrated to target doses, as tolerated, before assessing the resting heart rate for consideration of ivabradine initiation.

logic_node.action: Consider digoxin to decrease HF hospitalizations
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with symptomatic HFrEF despite GDMT (or who are unable to tolerate GDMT), digoxin might be considered to decrease hospitalizations for HF. The benefit of digoxin in patients with HF remains controversial; GDMT is expected to be optimized before considering addition of digoxin.

source_text: In patients with symptomatic HFrEF despite GDMT (or who are unable to tolerate GDMT), digoxin might be considered to decrease hospitalizations for HF.

logic_node.action: Digoxin dosing: start 0.125-0.25 mg daily, target serum level 0.5-<0.9 ng/mL
logic_node.action_detail: Digoxin is commonly initiated and maintained at 0.125-0.25 mg daily. Target serum digoxin concentration 0.5 to <0.9 ng/mL. Higher doses (0.375-0.50 mg daily) are rarely needed. Serum concentrations >=1.2 ng/mL associated with increased mortality risk.

source_text: Digoxin: 0.125-0.25 mg daily, individualized to serum digoxin concentration 0.5-<0.9 ng/mL. Risk of death independently associated with serum digoxin concentration >=1.2 ng/mL and >=1.6 ng/mL.

logic_node.action: Use low-dose digoxin (0.125 mg daily or every other day) in elderly
logic_node.action_detail: Low doses of digoxin (0.125 mg daily or every other day) should be used initially if the patient is >70 years of age, has impaired renal function, or has a low lean body mass.

source_text: Low doses (0.125 mg daily or every other day) should be used initially if the patient is >70 years of age, has impaired renal function, or has a low lean body mass.

logic_node.action: Monitor serum digoxin concentration, target <0.9 ng/mL
logic_node.action_detail: Serum digoxin concentration should be monitored with a target of 0.5 to <0.9 ng/mL. Risk of death is independently associated with serum digoxin concentration >=1.2 ng/mL. Concentrations >=1.6 ng/mL carry significantly higher mortality risk.

source_text: The risk of death was independently associated with serum digoxin concentration, with a significantly higher risk observed in those with concentrations >=1.2 ng/mL and >=1.6 ng/mL.

logic_node.action: Consider vericiguat for high-risk worsening HFrEF
logic_node.action_detail: In selected high-risk patients with HFrEF and recent worsening of HF already on GDMT, oral soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator (vericiguat) may be considered to reduce HF hospitalization and cardiovascular death. Patients must have elevated natriuretic peptides (BNP >=300 pg/mL or NT-proBNP >=1000 pg/mL) and recent HF worsening.

source_text: In selected high-risk patients with HFrEF and recent worsening of HF already on GDMT, an oral soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator (vericiguat) may be considered to reduce HF hospitalization and cardiovascular death.

logic_node.action: Vericiguat dosing: start 2.5 mg daily, target 10 mg daily
logic_node.action_detail: Vericiguat for HFrEF: initial dose 2.5 mg once daily, target dose 10 mg once daily. Mean dose achieved in clinical trials: 9.2 mg total daily.

source_text: Vericiguat: 2.5 mg once daily initial, 10 mg once daily target, 9.2 mg total daily mean in trials.

logic_node.action: Exclude vericiguat if SBP <100 mmHg
logic_node.action_detail: Patients with SBP <100 mm Hg were excluded from the VICTORIA trial. Symptomatic hypotension (9.1% vs 7.9%) and syncope (4.0% vs 3.5%) were numerically higher in the vericiguat group.

source_text: Patients on long-acting nitrates, with SBP <100 mm Hg, or eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73 m2 were excluded. Symptomatic hypotension (9.1% versus 7.9%) and syncope (4.0% versus 3.5%) were numerically higher in the vericiguat group.

logic_node.action: Exclude vericiguat if eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73m2
logic_node.action_detail: Patients with eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73 m2 were excluded from the VICTORIA trial of vericiguat in HFrEF.

source_text: Patients on long-acting nitrates, with SBP <100 mm Hg, or eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73 m2 were excluded.

logic_node.action: Avoid vericiguat with long-acting nitrates
logic_node.action_detail: Patients on long-acting nitrates were excluded from the VICTORIA trial of vericiguat due to potential interaction via the NO-sGC-cGMP pathway. Vericiguat directly stimulates soluble guanylyl cyclase and increases cGMP production.

source_text: Patients on long-acting nitrates, with SBP <100 mm Hg, or eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73 m2 were excluded.

logic_node.action: Vericiguat may lack benefit if NT-proBNP >5314 pg/mL
logic_node.action_detail: Patients in the highest quartile of NT-proBNP subgroup (NT-proBNP level >5314 pg/mL) did not have benefit from vericiguat when compared with placebo in the VICTORIA trial. There was heterogeneity by subgroup analysis.

source_text: Patients in the highest quartile of NT-proBNP subgroup (NT proBNP level >5314 pg/mL) did not have benefit from vericiguat when compared with placebo.

logic_node.action: Use highest tolerated dose if target dose not achievable
logic_node.action_detail: If the target dose of HFrEF medications cannot be achieved or is not well tolerated, then the highest tolerated dose is recommended. Approximately 70-85% of patients in clinical trials were able to achieve and maintain trial-defined target doses.

source_text: If the target dose cannot be achieved or is not well tolerated, then the highest tolerated dose is recommended. Most patients (approximately 70%-85%) were able to tolerate and achieve the trial defined target dose.
